reasoning: The icon clearly depicts the star and crescent enclosed within the Rub el Hizb (eight-pointed Islamic star), universally recognized as an emblem of Islam. It fits tasks related to Muslim religious observance, prayers, Quran study, Zakat, Ramadan, and Eid, while the distinctive octagonal frame prevents confusion with a simple nighttime or sleep moon icon.
